items.title: Brother PowerNote PN-8500MDS

items.title: Polaroid Automatic 340

items.excerpt_en: A Polaroid Automatic 340 folding pack-film camera.

items.description_en: With its folding body and instant-photography concept, it represents Polaroid’s pack-film era. Its original film system is not the same as current integral Polaroid film, so consumable compatibility requires separate research.
items.label_notes_tr: Model adı fotoğrafta Polaroid Automatic 340 olarak okunuyor.
items.label_notes_en: The model name reads Polaroid Automatic 340 in the photograph.
